rebuild.note: 0 newly broken vs the seed's 0 pre-existing; 0 new warnings (reported, not failed)

policy.handedness: mirror about plane_x (dpad <-> face_buttons swap sides)

rebuild health.evidence: fraction of features newly broken versus the seed census. Pre-existing seed errors are not charged to the candidate.

sketch_definition.note: sketches in a constraint status the seed never had

modelling hygiene.evidence: model quality as a delta against the seed: new rebuild warnings, sketches leaving their seed constraint state, features suppressed rather than removed, new external references.
notes: external reference census unavailable: no supported API on this SolidWorks build

widened by 15 mm.evidence: half: mirror-pair separation growth against +15 mm (asymmetric: undershoot reaches 0 at delta=0, overshoot decays more slowly); half: growth of the housing halves' separation (area-weighted face X either side of the plane): full credit from +15 mm to +30 mm, rising from 0 below, falling to 0 at +45 mm.

controls_follow_grips.note: reported only; not part of the score

clusters at mirrored positions.evidence: button diamonds must land where the mirror plus the candidate's own widening puts them, and travel as rigid units. Graded against the applied widening rather than the nominal 7.5 mm, which keeps it independent of c1. Symmetric pairs are excluded: invariant as a set, their mean centre proves nothing.

no new control interference.evidence: boolean-intersect volume among control bodies and control-vs-housing.  Hardware the candidate adds (screws in bosses) is out of scope -- the reference seats screws by design

sticks.note: cluster straddles the plane; it has no side to change

cluster_sides.note: ROLE-WEIGHTED fraction of off-plane clusters that changed side, so moving one button cluster across and forgetting the other scores about half, not zero. Clusters straddling the plane are UNVERIFIABLE, not free passes.

port_lights_side.note: port-light glyphs are wireless-port indicators, not a handed control -- they must stay on their original side of the plane. This is the ONLY witness that separates a proper left-hand conversion from a naive whole-part mirror, hence its weight.

housing_detail_side.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, CARRIES NO WEIGHT. Area-weighted left/right balance of engraving-scale housing faces -- the START/SELECT labels among them. A sign flip means they crossed the plane, which instruction.md requires, so this cannot guard against a naive mirror: both move them. Measured, the naive-flip adversary and the reference read +0.19 and +0.20. port_lights_side is what separates those two.

symbol_glyphs.note: PS triangle/circle/cross/square are left-right symmetric split-faces; a mirror is geometrically undetectable on the symbols themselves.  Handedness is graded from cluster sides, body inertia signs and the housing side signature instead.  Carries no weight -- it is UNVERIFIABLE by construction, not by accident.

tree_and_faces.note: diagnostic only -- not scored. The reshape check cannot see inside an exempt body, so these are the only trace an unrequested edit there leaves. They carry no threshold: this corpus's trees differ too much between authors for one to be honest.

no unrequested changes.caveat: housing, button diamonds and centre buttons are exempt from the reshape check -- the reference remodels them.  Sticks/triggers/bumpers must keep their shape.  Scored by weight, not as a gate.  Inside the housing, skin_splits catches a shallow insert (0.1 to 0.3 mm) on skin the task did not ask to change; a taller one, or one on the reshaped grips or near a control, is not caught: see detail.tree_and_faces for the trace it leaves.

dpad_arrows.note: NOT SCORED -- the reference rebuilds the cross and simplifies its arrows (44 faces in the seed, 20 in every converted model), so this separates nothing and would charge the reference for it.

markings preserved.evidence: face-button engraving: 50 of the seed's 50 engraving-scale faces retained (100%)
markings preserved.caveat: counts engraving-scale faces on the round-button cluster, which is where the four PS symbols are cut.  It reads PRESENCE, not orientation -- the symbols are left-right symmetric, so a mirrored symbol is geometrically identical to an upright one and is the naive-flip guard's business, not this criterion's.
